about.title: About Me
about.message:
My name is Supawich (RYU). I graduated from King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok with a degree in Electronic Computer Technology.

I specialize primarily in Frontend Development, crafting high-performance, responsive web & mobile interfaces with React, Next.js, React Native, and TypeScript.

I actively leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery, using my solid frontend foundation to architect solutions and engineer precise prompts. Combined with hands-on experience collaborating alongside backend teams (Spring Boot, Supabase, PostgreSQL), I ensure clean REST API integration and seamless full-cycle execution.

items.description: Developed and maintained enterprise Cloud ERP frontends using JSP and React for internal projects like PMS and ERP (New TechStack). Designed and built responsive, user-friendly UIs and collaborated with the backend team on API integrations and Oracle PL/SQL database queries.
Administered local campus network infrastructure, configured hardware peripherals, and delivered fast technical support across departments.
Diagnosed PC system faults, assembled custom high-performance builds, and performed hardware/software repairs for retail clients.
